evidence.reason: The cited predicate treats every finding-quoted span as positive trigger evidence. The nearby ambiguity guard only catches an ambiguous quoted name that survives in the after content; it does not exclude an ambiguous name that is renamed away. Thus a rename such as `accept` to `validate`, while preserving `validate(Infinity) === true`, can pass `trigger-removed` and, with dependency completeness attested, yield `resolved`. Excluding ambiguous spans from positive trigger evidence and returning `uncertain`/`no-citable-trigger` when no supported span remains is the smallest compatible correctness fix.
